source_title: Bank of Russia official daily currency rates
method: Actual HTTPS GET through CachedHttpClient(record); original XML encoding retained. No synthetic currency rates. Effective date comes from ValCurs/@Date, not download date.
limitations: Official CBR reference rates, not a commercial exchange or booking quote.
Offline replay remains a fixed historical snapshot; inspect effective_date and age_days before use.
No default max age is a CBR guarantee; application policy decides whether to accept stale or future-effective rates.
